summary: The Warriors score 44 before halftime and leave Akron with a 44-point win.
article_headline: Walsh Jesuit Explodes in First Half, Defeats STVM 51–7
article_dek: The Warriors score 44 before halftime and leave Akron with a 44-point win.
article_body:
AKRON, Ohio — Walsh Jesuit defeated St. Vincent–St. Mary 51–7 on October 17, 2025, using a dominant first half to put the result out of reach early.

The Warriors scored 14 in the first quarter and 30 in the second, building a 44–0 halftime lead. Walsh added another touchdown in the third before the Fighting Irish recorded their seven points in the fourth quarter.

Although the Irish lost, the STVM athletics department singled out Geovonni Vinson's defensive play against Walsh in its end-of-season review. Summit County Sports' photo coverage records the action around the matchup.
article_highlights: Walsh Jesuit led 14–0 after the first quarter and added 30 points in the second to take a 44–0 halftime advantage.
The Warriors added seven points in the third quarter; STVM scored its seven points in the fourth.
STVM's Geovonni Vinson was later highlighted by the school's athletics department for his defensive performance against Walsh.
